_about: Chat templates for checkpoints that ship none in their tokenizer. AUTHORED, not derived -- each template is sourced from the model's own training code, documentation, or repo, and cited below. A wrong template measures template-mismatch, not alignment, so these are conservative rather than inventive.
_how_used: runners.load_for_twp sets tok.chat_template from this file when the tokenizer ships none. The override is logged. A model absent here AND absent in the tokenizer gets no template and cannot be framed -- which is the correct outcome for bloomz-7b1 and CT-LLM-SFT-DPO.
_verified: Each template was tested on the loaded model with 'She was so angry she wanted to' and confirmed to produce coherent assistant-mode output (top-1 mass on a response word, not a continuation word). See the session that produced them.

BAAI/AquilaChat2-7B.source: predict.py in the model repo: template_map['AquilaChat2-7B'] -> 'aquila-v1' (NO_COLON_TWO style). Tokens <|startofpiece|>/<|endofpiece|> verified in added_tokens.json (ids 100000/100001).
BAAI/AquilaChat2-7B.template: {% for m in messages %}{% if m['role']=='user' %}<|startofpiece|>{{ m['content'] }}{% elif m['role']=='assistant' %}<|endofpiece|>{{ m['content'] }}</s>{% endif %}{% endfor %}{% if add_generation_prompt %}<|endofpiece|>{% endif %}
BAAI/AquilaChat2-7B.gotchas: Three OTHER templates in the same file belong to AquilaChat2-34B/-16K and legacy Aquila-v1, NOT this checkpoint.

LLM360/AmberSafe.source: github.com/LLM360/amber-train instruction_finetune.sh -> FastChat train_mem.py; FastChat conversation.py get_conversation_template('vicuna') -> vicuna_v1.1. AmberChat's actual SFT training format. TESTED: Vicuna produces 84% mass on 'I' (assistant response mode); alternatives produce 57% or less.
LLM360/AmberSafe.template: {{ 'A chat between a curious user and an artificial intelligence assistant. The assistant gives helpful, detailed, and polite answers to the user\'s questions. ' }}{% for m in messages %}{% if m['role']=='user' %}USER: {{ m['content'] }} {% elif m['role']=='assistant' %}ASSISTANT: {{ m['content'] }}</s>{% endif %}{% endfor %}{% if add_generation_prompt %}ASSISTANT:{% endif %}
LLM360/AmberSafe.gotchas: Four sources disagree (###Human, Vicuna, USER/ASSISTANT bare, raw). Vicuna v1.1 won on inference testing. AmberSafe's own DPO stage trained on bare unwrapped PKU-SafeRLHF prompts, so this template matches the SFT base (AmberChat) rather than the final DPO step.

RWKV/rwkv-raven-7b.source: BlinkDL/rwkv-4-raven README (author's own card, explicitly labeled 'Best Prompt Format'): Bob/Alice persona names. TESTED: Bob/Alice and User/Bot both work (27% vs 24% on 'I'); ###Instruction/###Response is DEAD (100% mass on newline). Author's format chosen.
RWKV/rwkv-raven-7b.gotchas: RWKV is a non-transformer RNN with no chat-token vocabulary. Trained on a MIX of formats (Alpaca, CodeAlpaca, Guanaco, GPT4All, ShareGPT), so multiple conventions partially work. Bob/Alice is the author's stated best.

baichuan-inc/Baichuan2-7B-Chat.source: generation_config.json (user_token_id=195, assistant_token_id=196) + generation_utils.py build_chat_input in the model repo. Tokens decode as <reserved_106>/<reserved_107> via sentencepiece. Corroborated by official fine-tune.py.
baichuan-inc/Baichuan2-7B-Chat.template: {% if messages[0]['role']=='system' %}{{ messages[0]['content'] }}{% set messages = messages[1:] %}{% endif %}{% for m in messages %}{% if m['role']=='user' %}<reserved_106>{{ m['content'] }}{% elif m['role']=='assistant' %}<reserved_107>{{ m['content'] }}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{% if add_generation_prompt %}<reserved_107>{% endif %}
baichuan-inc/Baichuan2-7B-Chat.gotchas: tokenizer_config.json sets add_bos_token=false, overriding the class default. Must load via from_pretrained on this exact repo.

gl198976/mpt-7b-instruct.gotchas: Single-turn only -- multi-turn is undocumented. Requires trust_remote_code=True for the model, not the tokenizer.
